renderings.value: Of course "Hayabusa" is not actually closing in on the Sun, it is just positioned as in the figure so that, seen from the Earth, it is on the opposite side of the Sun; this is called 'conjunction'.
When I was in Paris, I became acquainted with two or three painters, and I went to visit their atelier from time to time. I was always fascinated by their method of work and their way of life.
One time, I went to the atelier of a painter I had just met in the middle of the night. It was a dark room in an attic.
Cook about one and a half cup of rice.
